declarations.coverage: Drafted from the repository tree by `discovery/draft-documentation-scope.mjs`: every file Git keeps under the documentation root `docs`, a new index for each of its directories without one, the development guide, and the domain glossaries and context maps the rules identify. Paths other declarations own are left out, and so is each README.md outside the documentation roots. Link-repair files and move destinations enter when the work needs them. Fresh review confirms docs is the only documentation root and all existing indices are present; no new indices, moves, or link-repair destinations are indicated. The three remaining drafter questions are resolved by inspecting acceptance fixtures and their harness, published example-source content, and packaged product skill sources. Those files remain excluded. The installed .agents/skills/standards-updates system skill is present and correctly reserved by the v0.5.2 drafter; no question or documentation candidate names that installed path. The separate skills/standards-updates/SKILL.md product-source question is resolved as an exclusion. Historical v0.5.0 scope is comparison context only; all 34 included documentation paths and all prior exclusions were reviewed against the current tree.

declarations.coverage: Fresh review of Git remotes identifies one unambiguous github.com repository, lutzseverino/repo-standards, for both origin fetch and push. This declaration governs remote configuration only; empty project-content scope is intentional. Both canonical-labels and pull-request-integration fixes are retained and disclosed for a later identity-confirmed adoption. This inspection authorizes or executes neither remote fix, and does not verify live access or remote settings.

package.json and pnpm-workspace.yaml describe a single maintained root TypeScript/Node.js CLI package with no workspace member packages. Its bootstrap, source, tests, scripts, acceptance harness and distributed product skills share the root build/release and development guide. Nested manifests belong to synthetic fixtures. No non-root directory satisfies the separate Project responsibility-and-development-command criterion; root README.md is explicitly governed by repository-readme. Empty included scope is intentional. Fresh inspection of the current manifest, workspace configuration, development guide, fixture harness, release packaging contract and component files confirms the same membership decisions; the previous proposal supplies historical context only. No missing Project README requires introduction.
